snippet.title: Merge Maestro How to Play
snippet.description: Merge tiles of the same type together to create higher level and more powerful ones to defeat ever more difficult waves of enemies. Craft your set with hundreds of unique Emojis to create thousands of powerful and wacky combinations. No two runs are ever the same in this quick, bite-sized rogue-like you can take anywhere.
